author: Mark Atwood
text: Recommendation: defer this bead until the workspace decides .50 (5-method sync hook pattern) wholesale. Pre-1.0 / pre-publish is the cheapest moment for the breaking change but bundling sync→async and per-account-args changes for ALL 5 sync hooks into ONE breaking commit gives downstream consumers a single migration step. Path B (separate beads, sequential commits) is also viable but costs N migration steps.
